Versus
 1. The State of Bihar.
 2. Vanita Mishra W/o Sri Vibhakar Mishra D/o Sri Bhagwan Deo Mishra, R/o
 Village- Bishunpur, P.S- Amour, Distt.- Purnea (Bihar).

... ... Respon
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Saket Tiwary, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Rajiv Nayan, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arun Kumar Jha
 Oral Order

It has come to my notice that some inadvertent error has crept in the order dated 24.11.2025 regarding the confirmation of judgment of conviction and order of sentence passed by the learned Appellate Court.

It has been mentioned in the aforementioned order that the learned trial Court convicted the petitioner under Section 498A of the IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and sentenced him to undergo simple imprisonment of three years with a fine of Rs. 1,000/- and simple imprisonment of six months with a fine of Rs. 1,000/- respectively.

However, the learned Appellate Court only affirmed the conviction and sentence passed under Section 498A of the IPC and did not find evidence to prove the charge under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Patna High Court CR. REV. No.585 of 2025(5) dt.03-02-2026 2.

In view of the above, the paragraph no. 7 of the order dated 24.11.2025 is modified and will deemed to be substituted by the following order:
"In the instant revision petition, the petitioner is challenging the order dated 22.03.2022 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Purnea in Criminal Appeal No. 31 of 2019

whereby and whereunder the learned Appellate Court confirmed the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 28.06.2019 passed by the learned Vibhakar Mishra vs The State Of Bihar on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99565937/
1 Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Purnea in Complaint Case No. 2214 of 2011,
whereby and whereunder the petitioner has been convicted under Section 498A of the IPC and has been sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment of three years with a fine of Rs. 1,000/-."
3.
